" ' Know me, 0 My Son, to be the brother of thy father 
Matsrishvat, famed as Mainaka, dwelling in the deep. 
Formerly, all the larger mountains were furnished with wings

Hearing of the conduct of those mountains, Mahendra, tbat

" For along time I travclled onward with speed till I observed
